APPROVE. Moving the loop body into `ParseContainer` and filtering non-objects with `Where` removes the `foreach`/`if`/`continue` complexity from `Parse` while preserving behaviour. `List.AddRange` on a lazy enumerable still adds items one at a time inside the same `try`, so partial results on an exception match the original, and the new code uses only constructs that already compiled.

I judged this by reading the diff only; I did not build or test it.
